clue.text: Piece of ground appositely by church

indicators.note: by means placed next to, so the church sits beside the first piece

parts.note: pat as an adverb means aptly, fittingly, just right

explanation.surface: A plot of land sits conveniently beside the parish church.
explanation.definitionFit: A small plot of land, such as a vegetable plot, is called a patch.

clue.text: It's less trouble than it seems to write an essay on a big cat

definitions.text: It's less trouble than it seems

indicators.note: in a down clue one piece written on another sits above it

parts.note: a paper is a written essay
a tiger is a big cat

explanation.surface: Composing a school essay about a big cat is easier than it looks.
explanation.definitionFit: A threat that looks fierce but is actually powerless is called by this idiom.

clue.text: Confident tax-avoidance scheme's almost complete

parts.note: a trust can be set up to shelter money from tax

indicators.note: almost takes off the final letter

parts.note: full means complete

explanation.surface: A tax dodge is nearly finished and its organiser is sure of himself.
explanation.definitionFit: Being trustful means confident in others, ready to believe them.

clue.text: Place for delicate blooms, once you put in water supply

indicators.note: put in places the archaic word for you inside the word for a water supply

parts.note: a hose supplies water to the garden
thou is an old, once-used word for you

explanation.surface: Gardener explains that a hose is needed for the tender flowers.
explanation.definitionFit: A heated greenhouse is used to grow tender plants out of season.

clue.text: Among children, a boy appears mature

indicators.note: among puts the next pieces in the middle of the word for children

parts.note: seed is an old word for offspring or descendants
a son is a boy child

explanation.surface: In a group of youngsters, one lad looks more grown up than the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: Seasoned means experienced and matured, as seasoned timber or a seasoned traveller.

clue.text: Have long, anxious wait for food

definitions.meaning: to fret over something for a long time
a slow-cooked dish of meat and vegetables

explanation.surface: Fretting while waiting for dinner to be served.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both to fret at length and a slow-cooked casserole.

clue.text: Inclines to be on these before 24

definitions.meaning: inclines here are sloping surfaces, a noun
skiers are on the runs before the evening entertainment of 24 across

explanation.surface: Hills one tackles before the evening's fun.
explanation.definitionFit: Inclines are gradients, and ski runs are the gradients you go down before the evening parties.

clue.text: Time to enter unsophisticated local

indicators.note: to enter puts the abbreviation inside the word for unsophisticated

parts.note: naive means unsophisticated, innocent

explanation.surface: A simple country person finally has time to come in.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of a place is a local, born there.

clue.text: Doctor starts to use generic version of this?

definitions.text: Doctor starts to use generic version of this?

indicators.note: starts to takes the first letter of each of the next two words

explanation.surface: A GP begins prescribing an unbranded copy of a medicine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'starts to' takes U and G from 'use' and 'generic'; the whole clue describes a doctor switching to a cheap copy of a medication.
explanation.definitionFit: Generic versions are copies of a branded medicine, which a doctor may prescribe instead.

clue.text: In cot, lie up, out of sorts, with this on?

definitions.text: In cot, lie up, out of sorts, with this on?

indicators.note: out of sorts suggests disorder, so the letters of the words before are jumbled

explanation.surface: A poorly person lying up in a little bed, wearing a dressing.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters of COT and LIE UP are rearranged; the whole clue then pictures the patient in bed wearing what is made.
explanation.definitionFit: A hot soothing dressing is applied to someone laid up and unwell; this is the remedy pictured.

clue.text: Talking over music, we hear, making a cover?

indicators.note: we hear signals that the word is judged by how it is spoken

parts.note: rapping is rhythmic speech delivered over a beat

explanation.surface: A rapper performing over a track is somehow putting a lid on things.
explanation.definitionFit: Paper or film put round a present or parcel forms a covering for it.

clue.text: No Easter break — that'll have repercussions

indicators.note: break smashes the letters before it into a new order

explanation.surface: Cancelling the spring holiday will have consequences.
explanation.walkthrough: 'break' looks like the Easter holiday, but it is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that resonates echoes on and has lasting effects.

clue.text: Food supplied in proportion to partners at table

parts.note: a ratio expresses a proportion between quantities
at the bridge table North and South play as partners

explanation.surface: Food handed out fairly in line with the number of dinner companions.
explanation.walkthrough: N and S (North and South) are a partnership in the card game bridge.
explanation.definitionFit: Rations are fixed allowances of food issued to soldiers or civilians.

clue.text: Getting a glimpse, having sound positioning

indicators.note: sound signals that the word for positioning is to be judged by its pronunciation

parts.note: siting is positioning something in a place

explanation.surface: Catching sight of something because one is well placed.
explanation.definitionFit: A sighting is a brief view, as of a rare bird.

clue.text: Demanding little 19 should enter plan

indicators.note: should enter places the short piece inside the word for plan

parts.note: an intent is an aim or plan
19 down's answer is a female sibling; a little or short form of it is sis

explanation.surface: A bossy younger girl insists on being included in the scheme.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Little 19' points to the answer at 19 down cut down to its familiar short form.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone demanding keeps pressing a point and will not let it drop.

clue.text: Obey 'on your marks' call

definitions.meaning: when a race is about to start, the runners are told to put their feet up to the start mark

explanation.surface: Doing as the starter says at the start of a race.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to conform, and literally is putting the feet at the start line.

clue.text: Generous offer within Midas's grasp?

parts.note: King Midas turned all he touched into gold, so shaking his hand would be a gilded grip; it is also a large pay-off for a departing executive

explanation.surface: A lavish deal that the gold-touching king could reach out and take.
explanation.definitionFit: A large severance payment given to a departing executive is a lavish parting gift, often called so.

clue.text: Mixed together, red tints are nastily loud

indicators.note: mixed together means the letters are stirred into a new order

explanation.surface: Blending colours gives a garish, jarring result.
explanation.definitionFit: A strident sound is harsh and grating, unpleasantly loud.

clue.text: Every sailor is completely confused

definitions.meaning: every sailor is afloat on the ocean, read literally

explanation.surface: Every seaman is thoroughly bewildered.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means utterly confused, and literally describes everyone being out on the ocean.

clue.text: During break, practise self-control

indicators.note: during places one activity in the middle of another, so one word goes inside the other

parts.note: a rest is a break
to train is to practise

explanation.surface: Using a pause from work to rehearse shows real discipline.
explanation.definitionFit: Restraint is holding oneself back, a synonym for self-discipline.

clue.text: Resist erroneously accepting tender

indicators.note: accepting means the words before it hold the answer within them, across the word break

explanation.surface: A nurse wrongly resists taking on something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'erroneously' looks like an anagram signal, but the letters sit in order across 'Resist erroneously'. 'tender' is one who tends: in Britain a senior nurse.
explanation.definitionFit: A senior nurse who tends patients is called this in British hospitals.

clue.text: Tell soldiers to come on behind

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British army corps
to come on behind schedule is to be late

explanation.surface: Ordering troops to bring up the rear.
explanation.definitionFit: To relate a story is to tell or recount it.

clue.text: Middle East country wants me back, I consider

indicators.note: back signals that the little word before it is read in the other direction

parts.note: to rate something is to consider or judge it

explanation.surface: A Gulf state wants its envoy returned, says the ruler.
explanation.definitionFit: The United Arab Emirates are made up of states ruled by emirs; one of them is a Gulf country.

clue.text: Comet's main body?

parts.note: the Comet was an early British jet airliner, and the main hull of a plane is meant, not the nucleus of a heavenly body

explanation.surface: An astronomer asks about the core of a comet.
explanation.walkthrough: The de Havilland Comet was the world's first jet airliner; the clue's astronomy is the decoy.
explanation.definitionFit: The central body of an aircraft, carrying crew and passengers, is its hull section.

clue.text: Glib? Change quickly

definitions.meaning: to turn over or switch abruptly

explanation.surface: A smooth talker suddenly changes his mind.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both flippant and to turn over or switch quickly.

clue.text: Relax as letters are read out

indicators.note: read out means the plural letter name is spoken aloud

parts.note: the letters here are E's, more than one letter E

explanation.surface: Unwind as the post is read to you.
explanation.definitionFit: To ease off is to relax and take it easy.

clue.text: A crush — half of kids missing this winter sports entertainment

parts.note: a press is a crush or crowd

indicators.note: half of takes just the first two of the four letters of the word kids

explanation.surface: A scrum at the ski lodge, with half the children absent, is the evening's fun.
explanation.walkthrough: 'missing this' is link padding: the half of KIDS kept is KI, the rest dropped.
explanation.definitionFit: The French term for after-skiing covers the social life and parties at a resort.

clue.text: Intractable salesman sent back poetry

indicators.note: sent back reverses the short word for a salesman

parts.note: a rep is a sales representative
verse is poetry

explanation.surface: A stubborn travelling seller has his poems returned to him.
explanation.definitionFit: Perverse means contrary and stubbornly unreasonable, hard to manage.

clue.text: Business requires some extra deliveries

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A firm needs a few additional shipments made.
explanation.definitionFit: Trade is commerce, buying and selling, which is what a business does.
